title: The order of work orders is shared by everyone at the location
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. A second dispatcher with Work Orders create and edit at the same location (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dispatcher Two"): Settings > Staff > add a staff member with a role that has Work Orders View and Create & Edit, enrolled at this location. Sign them in in a second browser.
  5. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  6. How to create each work order below:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the customer (add it from the window if it does not exist, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any asset > Create.
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to the technician named (leave it empty for an unassigned one).
    • Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate; approve the estimate for Approved; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing.
    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  7. Work orders (Approved), lead Ana: customers "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co", "ZZAUTOTEST Charlie Co". Nobody has reordered Ana's work in Tech View or Board View at this location yet, so they start in the List's default order (customer name A to Z): Alpha Co, Bravo Co, Charlie Co.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST" in Search so only your test work orders show.
  3. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (the design tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  4. In Ana's group, drag the Charlie Co row above the Alpha Co row and release.
  5. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  6. Read the order of the cards in Ana's column.
  7. In the second browser, as the second dispatcher, open Work Orders > All, search "ZZAUTOTEST", click Board View and read Ana's column, then click Tech View and read Ana's group.
  8. In the first browser, sign out, sign back in and open Work Orders > All > Tech View with the same search.
  9. In the first browser, drag Ben's group header above Ana's group (technician order), then in the second browser refresh and read the technician order.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: Ana's group reads Charlie Co, Alpha Co, Bravo Co.
  • Step 6: Board View shows the same order in Ana's column: Charlie Co, Alpha Co, Bravo Co.
  • Step 7: the second dispatcher sees Charlie Co, Alpha Co, Bravo Co in both views without doing anything (the work order order is saved once for the location).
  • Step 8: after signing in again the order is still Charlie Co, Alpha Co, Bravo Co: the saved order replaces the starting customer-name order and stays until someone changes it.
  • Step 9: the second dispatcher's technician order does not change (Ana before Ben): technician order is saved per user, unlike the work order order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R3, S9-R11, S9-R12, read 8 Oct 2026. Key Decisions (manual ordering), same PRD. Starting order (customer name A to Z): Review Decisions page 853901313, DR-45 (29 Sep 2026).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R3: “Once anyone at the location has reordered a technician’s work orders, use that saved order instead of the initial sort. Once a user has reordered technician groups/columns, use their saved order instead of the initial technician sort.”
  • S9-R11: “Save the manual order of work orders once per location. Everyone at the location sees the same order, in both Tech View and Board View. If two people reorder at the same time, the later save wins; the other person sees the saved order on their next refresh and is not warned.”
  • S9-R12: “The manual order of work orders stays until someone changes it. Technician group/column order and pins are saved per user (S9-R2, S3-R18).”
  • Key decision: manual ordering: “That order is the shop’s priority plan, so it is saved once per location and everyone at the location sees the same order, in Tech View and Board View alike.”
